findings.title: Verify 字源 scan finding for 75C5
findings.details: [OCR CORRECTION REQUIRED] 字源 PDF p. 684 (printed p. 671), 病 entry immediately after 「形声字。从疒,丙声」: provisional OCR excerpt records 「形声字。从疒,丙声(或从方声)」, but the scan visibly reads 「形声字。从疒,丙声(或从方声)」? The scan text is confirmed as 「形声字。从疒,丙声(或从方声)」; no transcription correction is proposed for this phrase. However, the headword-line OCR records 「病 bìng 並纽、阳部;並纽、映韵、皮命切」 and matches the scan.
